Description.Name: Visor Strike Vehicle
Description.Details: The Prime configuration of the Visor Strike Vehicle mounts a Clan MTR/8 mortar in its hidden turret and two Clan ER Medium Lasers concealed in the front, together with a Battle Armor Compartment, which is usually enough fire support for the infantry it carries. Like every Visor it is built to look identical to a civilian Puller truck, so it passes as ordinary traffic until the crew deploys the turret or uncovers the lasers, while its Clan XL engine and Clan Ferro-Fibrous armor leave it little to fear from small arms. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 155 20 Left 110 20 Right 110 20 Rear 110 20 Turret 110 20 Total 595 100 Quirk: Easy to Maintain Can carry 3 Battle Armor Squads.

YangsThoughts: You'd never pick it out of traffic, Boss, because it looks just like a Puller, the civilian trailer truck nearly every industrial world builds. The Society wanted its undercover intervention teams to have heavy weapons close at hand, so the turret's tucked into the worker compartment behind the cab and the rest of the guns stay covered until the crew needs them. Underneath, though, it's no truck. They gave it a bigger XL fusion engine and thicker Clan-grade ferro-fibrous armor, so small arms won't bother it much, and with thirteen tons of pod space it can handle most support jobs.
